title: The Meaning of an Unfinished Sentence
title_ja: 途中で終わった文の意味
fact_notes: 人物、具体的な出来事・実験・記録は架空の教材例。実在の調査や統計の結果ではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: While preparing a short play for the school festival, a group of students encountered an unexpected difficulty with one line of dialogue.
sentences.ja: 学校祭での短い劇を準備していた生徒のグループは、ある台詞で予想外の難しさに直面した。

sentences.en: In the scene, one character invited another to join a trip, but the second character began to answer and then suddenly stopped speaking.
sentences.ja: その場面で一人の登場人物がもう一人を旅行に誘うが、二人目は答え始めた後、急に話すのをやめる。

sentences.en: The script contained no explanation of why the character left the sentence incomplete, so the actors initially disagreed about its meaning.
sentences.ja: 脚本には台詞を途中で終えた理由が書かれておらず、役者たちは当初その意味について意見が分かれた。

sentences.en: Some thought the character wanted to refuse the invitation politely, while others believed the character was about to express excitement.
sentences.ja: 丁寧に誘いを断りたかったと考える人もいれば、喜びを表そうとしていたと考える人もいた。

sentences.en: Their teacher suggested examining the events that had occurred before the unfinished sentence rather than treating the line as an isolated expression.
sentences.ja: 教師は台詞を独立した表現として扱うのではなく、途中で終わる文の前に起こった出来事を調べるよう提案した。

sentences.en: Earlier in the play, the second character had promised to help a family member on the day of the proposed trip.
sentences.ja: 劇の前半で、二人目の人物は旅行が予定されている日に家族を手伝うと約束していた。

sentences.en: However, the first character did not know about that promise and expected the invitation to be accepted without any difficulty.
sentences.ja: しかし一人目の人物はその約束を知らず、問題なく誘いが受け入れられると期待していた。

sentences.en: These details made the hesitation more understandable, although they did not completely determine how the actor should perform the line.
sentences.ja: これらの詳細からためらいを理解しやすくなったが、役者が台詞をどう演じるべきかまでは完全に決まらなかった。

sentences.en: During rehearsal, the students performed the scene in three different ways without making any changes to the written words in the script.
sentences.ja: 練習中、生徒たちは脚本の言葉を一切変えずに場面を三つの異なる方法で演じた。

sentences.en: They experimented with the length of the pause, the direction of the character's gaze, and the volume of the character's voice.
sentences.ja: 間の長さ、視線の方向、声の大きさを変えて試した。

sentences.en: In one version, the character appeared unwilling to go, whereas another version suggested disappointment at being unable to accept the invitation.
sentences.ja: 一つの演じ方では行く気がないように見え、別の演じ方では誘いを受けられないことへの落胆が伝わった。

sentences.en: The students recorded the different performances so they could compare the impressions produced by each version of the same line.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは同じ台詞の各演じ方が生む印象を比較するため、演技を録画した。

sentences.en: Later, the group invited several classmates to watch the recordings and explain which details supported their interpretations of the scene.
sentences.ja: 後にグループはクラスメート数人に録画を見てもらい、どの詳細が場面の解釈を支えるか説明するよう求めた。

sentences.en: The viewers did not always agree, and some noticed features of the performances that the actors themselves had overlooked.
sentences.ja: 見る人の意見は必ずしも一致せず、役者自身が見落としていた演技の特徴に気づく人もいた。

sentences.en: Rather than selecting a version by simply counting votes, the group discussed which interpretation best fitted the character's earlier actions.
sentences.ja: 単純に投票数で演じ方を選ばず、その人物の以前の行動に最も合う解釈を議論した。

sentences.en: They eventually chose a performance that communicated both the desire to join the trip and the difficulty of keeping two commitments.
sentences.ja: 最終的に旅行に行きたい気持ちと二つの約束を守る難しさの両方を伝える演技を選んだ。

sentences.en: The experience helped the students recognize that meaning is not always contained entirely within the words of a single sentence.
sentences.ja: この体験は、一文の言葉だけに意味がすべて含まれるわけではないと生徒が認識する助けになった。

sentences.en: Context can provide reasons for an interpretation, while features of a performance can influence how an audience understands those reasons.
sentences.ja: 文脈が解釈の理由を示し、演技の特徴は観客がその理由をどう理解するかに影響し得る。

sentences.en: At the same time, an interpretation becomes more persuasive when it can be supported by details available in the work itself.
sentences.ja: 同時に、作品自体にある細部によって裏付けられる解釈はより説得力を持つ。

sentences.en: For the students, reading the unfinished sentence closely meant paying attention to what the character had done, what had been said, and what remained unsaid.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちにとって途中で終わった文を精読するとは、人物がしたこと、言われたこと、言われずに残ったことに注意を払うことだった。

questions.prompt: Why did the actors disagree about the line?
options: The script contained two entirely different endings.
The teacher had removed the invitation from the scene.
The script did not explain why the character stopped speaking.
The actors had not received copies of the script.
questions.explanation_ja: 文が途中で終わった理由の説明がなかった。

questions.prompt: What had the second character promised earlier?
options: To organize the school festival alone.
To help a family member on the day of the trip.
To invite a different actor on the trip.
To complete the script before rehearsal.
questions.explanation_ja: 旅行の日に家族を手伝うと約束していた。

questions.prompt: Why did the earlier events help explain the character's hesitation?
options: They revealed a conflict between the invitation and an existing commitment.
They showed that the two characters disliked each other.
They proved that the trip had already been canceled.
They established the exact length of the pause in the script.
questions.explanation_ja: 誘いと既存の約束が重なることが分かった。

questions.prompt: Which feature did the actors vary in rehearsal?
options: The identity of the family member.
The date of the proposed trip.
The written wording of the invitation.
The direction of the character's gaze.

questions.prompt: What did the recordings demonstrate to the students?
options: The script had to be rewritten to create any new meaning.
The loudest performance was always understood correctly.
Identical words can produce different impressions when performed differently.
All viewers necessarily interpret a pause in the same way.
questions.explanation_ja: 同じ言葉でも演じ方により印象が異なる。

questions.prompt: What were classmates asked to explain?
options: Which details supported their understanding of the scene.
How many actors had written the play.
What the theater tickets should cost.
Which characters appeared in every scene.
questions.explanation_ja: 解釈の根拠となる細部を説明した。

options: Looked at carefully.
Deliberately invented.
Rehearsed many times.
Failed to notice.
questions.explanation_ja: 見落としたという意味。

questions.prompt: Why did the group avoid choosing only by vote count?
options: They believed all classmates had copied one answer.
They wanted a performance consistent with the character's earlier actions.
They did not want to finish the play.
They thought the earlier scenes had no importance.
questions.explanation_ja: 以前の行動と合う解釈を重視した。

questions.prompt: What did the selected performance communicate?
options: A complete lack of interest in both activities.
A desire to end the friendship immediately.
A decision to cancel the family plan without discussion.
A wish to go and difficulty honoring two commitments.
questions.explanation_ja: 旅行したい気持ちと二つの約束の難しさを表した。

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the passage's argument?
options: Every text has exactly one possible performance.
The wording of a line never matters to its meaning.
Interpretation should consider context, performance, and evidence within the work.
The most popular interpretation is always the most convincing.
questions.explanation_ja: 文脈と演技、作品にある根拠を考慮する。

grammar.focus: why the character left the sentence incomplete
grammar.explanation_ja: why節がexplanationの内容を示す。leave＋目的語＋補語で〜をある状態にしておく。

grammar.focus: rather than treating the line as an isolated expression
grammar.explanation_ja: rather than＋動名詞は別の行動との対比。
whereasは二つの演技が与える印象を対比する。

grammar.focus: when it can be supported by details available in the work itself
grammar.explanation_ja: whenは説得力が増す条件を示し、can be supportedは受動態。

discourse.role_ja: 二つの初期解釈を対比。
二人の人物が知っている情報の差を示す。
投票だけでなく根拠を検討する方針。
文脈の重要性に加え根拠のある解釈の必要性を示す。

paraphrases.source: The script contained no explanation of why the character left the sentence incomplete, so the actors initially disagreed about its meaning.
paraphrases.rewrite: The actors initially had different views because the script did not tell them why the character stopped before completing the sentence.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 脚本に理由がなく意見が分かれた。

paraphrases.source: Their teacher suggested examining the events that had occurred before the unfinished sentence rather than treating the line as an isolated expression.
paraphrases.rewrite: The teacher advised them to look at the preceding events instead of examining the line independently of the rest of the play.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 台詞を単独ではなく前の出来事と関連づけた。

paraphrases.source: In one version, the character appeared unwilling to go, whereas another version suggested disappointment at being unable to accept the invitation.
paraphrases.rewrite: One performance made the character seem reluctant, while the other implied sadness about not being able to join the trip.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 一方は乗り気でなく、もう一方は行けない落胆を示した。

paraphrases.source: At the same time, an interpretation becomes more persuasive when it can be supported by details available in the work itself.
paraphrases.rewrite: An interpretation is more convincing if evidence for it can be found within the work.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 作品中の根拠があれば解釈は説得力を持つ。
